dropFamilies.祭: サツ would show on 祭 and 際, read さい; 察/擦 already have 察 (さつ)
dropFamilies.券: 拳 and 圏 share only 龹 with 券; no 刀
dropFamilies.疋: 定 and 是 end in 龰 (一 + 止), not 疋; only part of the shape is there
dropFamilies.士: 支 is 十 + 又, no 士; 枝 and 肢 contain 支, not 士. The release's own 士 family is kept
dropFamilies.糸: 糸 is し; 係's sound part is 系 (a meaning compound of hand + thread). As a head, 糸 would claim kanji with 糸 are often けい

keepFamilies.果: 課 菓 are か, like 果 (結果); the kanji with 果 that aren't (巣 裸 彙) are rarer
keepFamilies.里: 理 (理由, 料理) is one of the most common kanji and is り, like 里
keepFamilies.未: 味 (and 魅) are み, like 未; 味 is very common
keepFamilies.分: 粉 紛 are ふん, like 分; 分 and 粉 are common
keepFamilies.羊: 洋 養 are よう, like 羊; both are common
keepFamilies.几: 机 肌 飢 pass the rule anyway; listed so it stays if the rule changes. Weak (机 is つくえ, 肌 is はだ): revisit later
keepFamilies.小: 少 省 are しょう, like 小; kept for now, revisit later (user)
keepFamilies.支: 枝 肢 are し, like 支; kept for now, revisit later (user)
